entries.title: Storm on the Horizon: Inside the AJCloud IoT Ecosystem
entries.description: Wi-Fi cameras are popular due to their affordability and convenience but often have security vulnerabilities that can be exploited.

entries.title: Kernel ETW is the best ETW
entries.description: This research focuses on the importance of native audit logs in secure-by-design software, emphasizing the need for kernel-level ETW logging over user-mode hooks to enhance anti-tamper protections.
